info.title: SFL Editorial API
info.summary: Prepare, preview and (on Owner approval) publish free editorial content into the seven Sentinel Fortune branches.
info.description:
One authenticated endpoint in front of the SFL Editorial Corridor.

THE RULES THIS API ENFORCES, which a caller should not try to work around:

1. An unclear instruction becomes PREPARE, never PUBLISH. If `operation` is omitted the API reads `user_message`; anything it cannot read clearly becomes a DRAFT and the response says `confident: false`. Tell the Owner "prepared — say the word to publish" rather than retrying with PUBLISH.
2. PUBLISH requires an Owner approval recorded out-of-band by the Owner. A client can never approve its own publication. `OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED` is the expected answer to publishing something unapproved; it is not an error to route around.
3. Every request needs a unique `instruction_id`. Re-sending the same one returns the original outcome and creates nothing — that is how a retry is made safe. Never reuse an id for a different piece of content, and never invent a new id just to retry.
4. `branch` is always explicit. The API will not guess a destination, and a house that does not publish a content type refuses it rather than redirecting it.
5. This API publishes FREE editorial work only. It cannot state a price, a pricing tier other than FREE, or a checkout link. Sending `price`, `compareAtPrice` or `checkoutUrl` is refused.

When `mode` is `TEST_PREVIEW`, publication is refused at the edge with `PUBLICATION_DISABLED`; prepare and preview work normally.

servers.description: Replace with the deployed Worker URL (wrangler deploy prints it).

get.summary: Is the API up, and is it in TEST_PREVIEW or LIVE mode?
The machine-readable action list, intents, rules and error schema.

post.summary: Run one editorial command: prepare, update, preview, publish, unpublish, archive, list or get.
post.description: The `operation` field chooses the action. Omit it only when relaying the Owner's own words in `user_message`, and expect PREPARE.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. When sent it MUST equal `instruction_id`, or the request is refused.

400.description: The request must be changed before retrying.

403.description: Not permitted — including OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED and PUBLICATION_DISABLED.

bearerAuth.description: The ChatGPT client's own token. It is not interchangeable with Claude's token or the Owner's token, and the credential — not any request field — decides which identity the call acts as.

operation.description: The action. Omit to have the API read `user_message` instead — which resolves to PREPARE whenever it is not unmistakably something else. LIST and GET are never inferred and must be stated.

instruction_id.description: REQUIRED and unique per distinct command. Re-sending the same id returns the original outcome and writes nothing. This is the replay protection — do not generate a new id in order to retry.

user_message.description: The Owner's own words, English or French, relayed verbatim. Used only when `operation` is absent.

record_id.description: Required for UPDATE, PREVIEW, PUBLISH, UNPUBLISH, ARCHIVE and GET. Returned as `record.id` by PREPARE.

branch.description: The destination house. Always explicit — the API never infers it. Ask the Owner rather than guessing.

content_type.description: Each house accepts only some of these. A refusal names which subject matter the house covers.

slug.description: Lowercase words joined by single hyphens. Unique within a house.

body.description: The editorial text. At least 20 characters.

translations.description: One record carries both languages — never create a second record for a translation.

cta.description: There is no purchase action. SUPPORT_THE_WORK is voluntary support for free work and is NOT a purchase; VIEW_PRODUCT may point at a product page but never at a cart or checkout.

Medium.description: Every asset must declare where it came from. SCRAPED is refused by name — benchmark or found imagery is never reused. APPROVED_PUBLIC additionally requires rights.licence and rights.approved === true.

confident.description: False when the API fell back to PREPARE. Say so to the Owner.

replay.description: True when this instruction_id had already been handled. Nothing new was created.

isLive.description: Whether this is publicly visible. Stated on every response so it never has to be inferred.

preview.description: PREVIEW only. Always carries preview: true and isLive: false — never describe it to the Owner as published.

step.description: Which pipeline step refused: COMMAND_VALIDATION, OWNER_AUTHORITY, NORMALIZE, IDENTITY_VALIDATION, EDITORIAL_VALIDATION, MEDIA_RIGHTS, PREVIEW_BUILD, APPROVAL_STATE or PUBLISH.

retryable.description: Only RATE_LIMITED, INTERNAL and NOT_CONFIGURED are worth retrying unchanged.
